# Self Storage India

> India's premier provider of private, secure, lockable self-storage rooms, household furniture storage, business warehousing, and vehicle storage across Delhi NCR.

Self Storage India (operated by Private Storage Solutions Pvt. Ltd.) is the pioneer of organized self-storage in India. We operate world-class facilities equipped with 24/7 CCTV surveillance, biometric access control, fire protection systems, and professional pest control.

## Core Storage Solutions

- [Household Goods Storage](https://selfstorageindia.com/household-goods-storage.html): Modular, private lockable storage rooms for home furniture, household appliances, seasonal belongings, and personal possessions.
- [Business Storage](https://selfstorageindia.com/business-storage.html): Secure commercial warehousing for excess e-commerce inventory, corporate document archives, office equipment, event collateral, and seasonal stock.
- [Private Rooms](https://selfstorageindia.com/offering-private-rooms.html): Individual lockable storage units ranging from 20 sq ft to 500+ sq ft with dedicated keys held exclusively by the customer.
- [Box & Document Storage](https://selfstorageindia.com/offering-box-storage.html): Archival storage solutions for tax files, legal records, personal lockers, and transient luggage.
- [Car & Vehicle Storage](https://selfstorageindia.com/terms-and-conditions.html#sec6): Dedicated covered vehicle bays for automobiles with flexible short-term and long-term plans.

## Operational & Financial Terms

- [Terms and Conditions](https://selfstorageindia.com/terms-and-conditions.html): Full legal and operational framework governing space rentals.
  - **Advance Rent:** 1st month's rent + applicable GST ("Total Rent") payable upfront prior to unit allocation.
  - **Security Deposit:** Refundable deposit equal to **3 times Total Monthly Rent**, held non-interest bearing.
  - **Notice Period:** Mandatory **30-day prior written notice** via email (`support@selfstorageindia.com`) for move-out and deposit refund processing.
  - **Minimum Lease Duration:** **30 Days** for standard storage rooms, lockers, and box storage; **7 Days** for car and vehicle storage.
  - **Prorated Billing:** Mid-month rentals calculated as `[(Total Rent / 30) × Remaining Days] + 1 Month Total Rent`.
  - **Prohibited Goods:** Flammables, explosives, toxic chemicals, perishable food, living creatures, firearms, and illegal contraband.
  - **Late Penalties & Lien Rights:** Grace period until 5th of month. Late fee of ₹500 or 2%/mo. Statutory possessory lien under Sec 170/171 Indian Contract Act, 1872 after 45 days default.

## Data Protection & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://selfstorageindia.com/privacy-policy.html): Comprehensive customer data protection policies.
  - **Zero Data Selling:** Personal information and corporate KYC documents are strictly confidential and never sold to third-party telemarketers.
  - **CCTV & Gate Logs:** 24/7 video surveillance archives retained for physical safety compliance and law enforcement audits.
  - **Rights Compliance:** Support for User Data Access, Rectification, Erasure, CCPA, and GDPR rights.
